plan_a_advantages: Includes a tempo run to improve speed and lactate threshold.
Incorporates an aerobic run for varied training stimulus.

reasoning: Plan A is the better choice for an athlete aiming to become a faster trail runner. While both plans incorporate rest days, Plan A includes a tempo run, which is crucial for improving speed and lactate threshold – a key factor in trail running performance. Plan B focuses almost exclusively on easy running, which is good for building a base but insufficient for developing speed. The inclusion of an aerobic run in Plan A also provides a different stimulus than the purely easy runs in Plan B, promoting more well-rounded development.
